tactical_evidence.claim: Prolonged exposure ignites; crowd tactic is illuminate each target long enough to ignite; some require more than one damage tick.

tactical_evidence.claim: Most light enemies can be ignited in one or two beam sweeps; some enemies cannot be ignited.
tactical_evidence.limitations: no speed, duration, target list, probability or reproducible measurement; indexed page old patch

tactical_evidence.claim: Sentry continues to fire when transitioning nearby targets, but normally targets until destroyed.
tactical_evidence.limitations: not evidence of deliberate ignition-and-switch strategy or quantified exposure

model_bounds.lower: Zero credited burn contribution when ignition is not established; direct beam damage remains separately modeled.
model_bounds.conditional_upper: If ignition is explicitly assumed at a stated time, bound post-ignition single Fire effect using 100 base DPS and up to 3 s within the chosen horizon, subject to target multiplier and penetration; this is a scenario bound, not established attainable gameplay maximum or multiple-refresh bound.
model_bounds.prohibited_inference: 50 ms is numerical direct-damage integration only; neither it nor listed 60 rpm is established as the engine status or damage tick. Do not turn it into guaranteed ignition or present a guessed dwell as measured.
